name: Skola Grovedancer
oracle_text:
Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, you gain 1 life.
{2}{G}: Mill a card. (Put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, you gain 1 life.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires once per card matching a filter (here: a land card, owner = you, i.e. into YOUR graveyard) put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield, hand (discard), library (mill, surveil), stack -- unbatched, so milling two lands gains 2 life
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no generic zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] only sees permanents leaving the battlefield and misses milled and discarded land cards, which this card's own {2}{G} mill ability is built to feed; discard covers only the hand; dies is creatures/permanents dying; leaves_graveyard is the opposite direction. The {2}{G}: mill 1 activated ability and the gain_life effect are expressible today.
